atoms.name: Demand paging and page faults
atoms.one_line: Pages load on first use; an invalid entry traps to the OS, which loads the page.

atoms.name: Page table size and PTE
atoms.one_line: Entries = 2^(VA - offset). Entry width from frame bits plus control bits, rounded to bytes.

atoms.name: Multi-level page tables
atoms.one_line: Each table fills a page; bits per level = log2(page / entry); count tables level by level.

atoms.name: TLB and effective access time
atoms.one_line: EAT = h(t + m) + (1 - h)(t + (L + 1) m). Tag = VPN - set-index bits. Reach = entries x page size.

atoms.name: EAT with page faults
atoms.one_line: EAT = (1 - p) m + p F; faults only follow a TLB miss when the page is absent.

atoms.name: FIFO, LRU, optimal
atoms.one_line: FIFO evicts the oldest load, LRU the least recent use, OPT the farthest next use.

atoms.name: Belady's anomaly and stack algorithms
atoms.one_line: FIFO can fault more with more frames. LRU and OPT never do.

atoms.name: Thrashing and working set
atoms.one_line: Working set = distinct pages in the last window. Thrashing = working sets exceed frames.
